Products & company6 offerings

About Mercor

Business group
Expert data & AI testing
Founded
2023
Legal entity
Mercor.io Corporation
Also works on
AI practice tasks, AI performance tests, Licensed training data

It also helps businesses put AI programs to work.

What Mercor sells

  • Human data & evals: Expert-authored training data and evaluations.
  • APEX Benchmarks: Tests of professional work, with task datasets for AI agents.
  • APEX-Agents: Tests extended professional work across several applications.
  • APEX-Accounting: Tests accounting work across applications. Developed with Ramp.
  • APEX-SWE: Tests software integration and observability (checking what software does while it runs). Developed with Cognition.
  • Enterprise AI: Builds AI agents for business tasks.

It did not name Meta.Apr 2026Customer changeReportedBusiness Insider · TechCrunch · Mercor

On July 21, 2026 the court stayed the case while the parties mediate.Apr 2026LawsuitStayed pending mediationCourtListener · U.S. District Court, N.D. Cal. · HR Dive
Scale AI sued Mercor and a former employee over trade secretsScale alleged that a former employee took confidential customer documents when he joined Mercor, which Mercor said it never accessed.
